Class FluidRenderer

java.lang.Object
fluid.FluidRenderer
public class FluidRenderer extends Object
Draws all the water as one neon metaball field: drops close to each other blend together, the surface gets a bright rim and the whole fluid a soft glow. Only the part of the view around the drops is computed.

  • Method Details

    • draw

      public void draw(Graphics2D g, List<Droplet> droplets, int viewX, int viewY, int width, int height)
      Draws the water seen in the view, with g drawing in the world. The grid is anchored on whole cells of the world, so moving the view doesn't make the water shimmer.
      Parameters:
      g - graphics drawing in the world
      droplets - the drops to draw
      viewX - left of the view, in world px
      viewY - top of the view, in world px
      width - width of the view, in px
      height - height of the view, in px

    • drawMarker

      y - centre y, in world px

    • drawAnchor

      public static void drawAnchor(Graphics2D g, double x, double y, double tension)
      Draws a ring where the back of a drop is stuck to the ground; it turns from cyan to red as the drop gets close to tearing.
      Parameters:
      g - graphics drawing in the world
      x - centre x, in world px
      y - centre y, in world px
      tension - how stretched the drop is, from 0 to 1 where it tears
